No sidecar UX file was created at any point (UX8): no ux.md, wireframes.md, flows.md, user-flows.md, or screens.md exists in the feature directory. PART 1 authored: the '## UI Wireframes' shell preamble (one Research Lab tool page, shared shell, four views Simple/Power/Brief/Journey through the standard #rlviews control per the Feature-012 four-view contract, Simple as the persisted default with a blank-proof fallback, plus the compute-once rule where all four views read one composed CombinedRegime plus one ordered SleeveFitRead list and a lever change recomputes through a single render() call, never a refetch, with Power canvases drawn synchronously from render() rather than deferred behind rAF); '### Screen Inventory'; '### UI Primitives' declaring 12 shared primitives satisfying UX9 (RegimeVerdictHeader, FacetRow, HorizonLane, ConfirmationDenominator, ContradictionCallout, RatioPairRow, SleeveFitRow, DataTruthBand, ProvenanceLine, UnavailableDetail, ContextualTooltip, TickerLink), each used by at least two of the four views with a stated composition rule and an explicit declaration that a per-screen copy is a defect; and the first two screens '### Screen: Simple — Regime Cockpit' and '### Screen: Power — Facet And Composition Evidence'. PART 2 authored: three further screens plus the flows section. '### Screen: Brief — Cited Regime Interpretation' encodes the Feature-012 rule that the Brief is LLM-authored ONLY from this tool's validated owner read plus a FROZEN cited WebEvidenceBundle — the wireframe shows a six-row authoring gate, the owner-read verdict block (read, never re-derived), the authored prose with inline [Cn] markers, a citation table naming BOTH origins per material claim with an explicit Independent? verdict and a same-origin collapse rule (two citations sharing one publisher, syndication feed, or upstream wire count as ONE origin), the sealed evidence bundle with its declared cutoff and its visible 'excluded — post-cutoff' list, and a SECOND full wireframe for the refusal state in which the prose and citation blocks are REPLACED (not hidden) by an explicit refusal naming each reason plus what-would-resolve, with no partial brief, no hedged brief, and no prose emitted at all. '### Screen: Journey — Guided Regime Goals' encodes noExecution: true with six ordered steps carrying aria-current=step, per-step evidence counts in n of m qualifying form, a transitive-stale marker showing the full dependency chain (step 4 ← step 2 ← credit facet), an explicitly STATED signoff withdrawal rather than a silent one, backtracking of aria-current to the earliest invalidated step, blocked downstream steps that withhold their preview rather than computing one on withdrawn evidence, and a completion packet whose terminal state is a reading record carrying an inseparable no-execution disclaimer (authorises nothing, publishes nothing, submits nothing, places no order). '### Screen: Mobile — Simple (under 600px)' is a single-column wireframe in which the three horizon lanes STACK in the fixed structural → swing → tactical order with lane labels and per-lane confirmation counts preserved, the composed confirmation denominator including its shrink clause is preserved as wrapped TEXT LINES rather than a ring/bar/gauge, and the body never gains a horizontal scrollbar at any width — the #rlviews segment and any wide table scroll only inside their own labeled, focusable containers, and long names/reasons wrap rather than ellipsise because the truncated tail carries the load-bearing qualification. '## User Flows' authored with 7 mermaid diagrams: (1) boot → cache-first first paint → delta refresh → composed verdict, branching to named archetype vs Mixed/Unresolved fingerprint; (2) facet staleness → unavailable → never-neutral → shrunken denominator → honest degraded verdict; (3) contradiction discovery → Power facet matrix → transition ledger with FLIPPED/HELD hysteresis detail, never averaged or majority-resolved; (4) sleeve relative-fit comparison → invalidation record with an explicit terminal state emitting relative fit and invalidation only; (5) ratio-pair inspection → adjacent declared window → family grouping → not-comparable branch; (6) Brief authoring gate → corroborated brief OR explicit refusal; (7) journey step → evidence check → transitive-stale backtrack → completion packet. UX3/UX4/UX5 satisfied on every one of the five screens: each carries **Interactions**, **Responsive behavior**, **Accessibility**, and **States**. Cross-cutting invariants held throughout: every state word is text plus a non-colour mark and never colour alone; every window-relative percentile or z-score renders its declared window as ADJACENT visible text rather than tooltip-only; every 'unavailable' renders reason plus what-would-resolve and is never a zero, a neutral value, or a bare dash; no weight, allocation, exposure, position size, target, or trade direction appears anywhere except inside explicit negative prohibition statements; and no journey terminal state contains any execution, publication, submission, or order concept. Screen Inventory was updated in place to mark Brief Read and Guided Regime Journey as 'New' (they were staged as 'New — part 2') and to add the Mobile — Simple (< 600px) row.
